description: FDraft (Dev) only — adds native folder-picker access for the Event Art Workspace setting (see docs/updates, 'EVENT STUDIO — PHASE 2' §7/§8). Only included when tauri.studio.conf.json's app.security.capabilities lists this file; normal FDraft never gets it, so the dialog API is unreachable from JS in the normal build even in principle, not just hidden from its UI.
